content: Nitrofurantoin is an antibacterial agent that is specifically used for the treatment of urinary tract infections. The MacroBID® brand of nitrofurantoin is presented as a hard gelatin capsule, which contains the equivalent of 100 mg of nitrofurantoin. This is composed of 25 mg of nitrofurantoin macrocrystals and 75 mg of nitrofurantoin monohydrate. The chemical name of nitrofurantoin macrocrystals is 1-[methylene]amino]-2,4-imidazolidinedione. The chemical name of nitrofurantoin monohydrate is 1-[methylene]amino]-2,4-imidazolidinedione monohydrate.
